claims.claim: Colour MFP with fastest in-class two-sided printing speed
claims.evidence: No model/spec plate visible; marketing claim cannot be checked from a single wrapped-unit photo.
No service/counter screen or page-count printout shown.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted
claims.evidence: Device is sealed in plastic; no open panel or cartridge photo provided.
No power-on or print-test photo/video; cannot confirm mechanical function.

risks.risk: Exact model unknown, which determines base market value
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the rating/model label or front panel model number
risks.if_unproven: cannot assign even a worst-case price; treat as unpriceable until model is readable

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may have print/scan/copy faults
risks.proof: Video of unit powering on and producing a test print/copy

risks.risk: Toner/cartridges may be empty, expired, or missing despite claim
risks.proof: Photo of open cartridge bay showing installed toner/drum

risks.risk: Page count claim could be false or inflated
risks.proof: Photo of printer's internal usage/counter report page

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic or structural damage under the plastic wrap
risks.proof: Photos with wrap removed, all sides and open covers/trays
risks.if_unproven: price as cosmetic condition unknown, assume moderate wear

risks.proof: Photo of all included cables and accessories laid out
risks.if_unproven: price as bare unit, no accessories

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model/serial rating label on the back or inside cover
Video of the printer powering on and completing a test print/copy
Photo of the internal usage/page-count report screen or printout
Photo of the open toner/drum bay showing cartridge condition
Unwrapped photos from all sides showing body condition
Photo of included cables and accessories
response.reason: The model, which sets the applicable price bracket, is unreadable in the single wrapped-unit photo, so even a worst-case price cannot be fixed until a model/serial shot is provided.
